limitations: Static saved-code inspection; no live target execution or attachment.
Sequential captured module does not include managed heap.
Direct scoped Ghidra; no REA Evidence ID.
Declared part references are preserved; active part registration during every scripted phase is not runtime observed.

reproduction.parameters: analyzeHeadless <private project directory> <new project> -import <target> -noanalysis -scriptPath <native-target directory> -postScript TraceToramTarget.java <index.json absolute path> <new output directory> -deleteProject
reproduction.environment: JVM application.settingsdir/cachedir/tempdir private writable paths. See build/tmp/toram-target-native/console*.log.
